labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something is broken or behaving incorrectly.

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: A request for new functionality or an improvement to existing behavior.

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Docs are missing, unclear, or incorrect.

labels.name: question
labels.description: The reporter is asking how to do something, not reporting a defect or requesting a feature.

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue substantially restates an existing open or closed issue.

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Acknowledged but the maintainer has decided not to act on it.

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Well-scoped and suitable for a first-time contributor.
